allow: PowerShell($root = Get-Location; $files = git ls-files | Where-Object { $_ -match '\\.\(tsx|ts|js|mjs|jsx|md\)$' }; $changedCount = 0; foreach \($f in $files\) { $path = Join-Path $root $f; $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $original = $content; $content = $content -replace 'Соёл-Эрдэм', 'Соёл Эрдэм'; $content = $content -replace 'СОЁЛ-ЭРДЭМ', 'СОЁЛ ЭРДЭМ'; if \($content -ne $original\) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText\($path, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new\($false\)\); $changedCount++ } }; Write-Host "Changed $changedCount files")
